summary: Queued pull requests that change different package files no longer conflict in `dist/`. The package provenance `dist/*/.agent-marketplace-package.json` no longer commits the shared build identity: schema 4 drops `build_id`, `source_ref`, `source_channel` and `source_commit`, and writes each file hash on a line of its own, so two changes to neighbouring files touch no adjacent lines. The deterministic snapshot `build_id` of the canonical sources is computed where it is needed: release preparation records it in `.release/stable.json`, the release replay reproduces it, `tools/release.py verify-release` recomputes it at a release commit, and the merge queue release gate lets only the release entry change it. Two queued PRs still conflict, and are refreshed, on changes to the same package file, adds at one sort position, an add after a changed last entry, a removal next to another removal or an add, and a removal of the last entry beside a change to the entry before it.
